sections.markdown:
## C2 — Licensing, curfew and paperwork confusables with knowledge-graph hints

FACT_ID: sec02-R01 | anchor: A10
The first six licensed months allow only an instructor, a licensed parent or guardian, or one qualified twenty plus adult aboard, while months seven through twelve add immediate family and nobody else. [A10]
Why it matters: group_hint passenger-windows; prereq_hint sec02-F19; difficulty_hint 3; confusable_with sec02-F19, sec02-F20.
Source: [A10 -> src:rdmv-ct-d:connecticut-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0010]
FACT_ID: sec02-R02 | anchor: A10
The eleven to five night curfew binds teen drivers except for job, school, worship, medical or Safe Ride trips, and a separate exemption covers volunteer crews on emergency duty. [A10]
Why it matters: group_hint curfew; prereq_hint sec02-F21; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec02-F21, sec02-F22.
Source: [A10 -> src:rdmv-ct-d:connecticut-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0010]
FACT_ID: sec02-R03 | anchor: A10
Overloading seatbelts, driving passenger or vanpool vehicles, touching any phone even hands free, and early motorcycle passengers are banned for both permit holders and licensed teens alike. [A10]
Why it matters: group_hint shared-bans; prereq_hint sec02-F23; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec02-F23, sec02-F19.
Source: [A10 -> src:rdmv-ct-d:connecticut-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0010]
FACT_ID: sec02-R04 | anchor: A09
Adults wait ninety permit days before the road test, whereas teens log forty road hours first, so the adult gate is time and the teen gate is practice. [A09]
Why it matters: group_hint eligibility-gates; prereq_hint sec02-F02; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec02-F01, sec02-F02.
Source: [A09 -> src:rdmv-ct-d:connecticut-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0009]
FACT_ID: sec02-R05 | anchor: A09
A leased test car passes only when its insurance names car and lease company, while a rental car fails outright for any unlicensed tester. [A09]
Why it matters: group_hint test-car; prereq_hint sec02-F10; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec02-F10, sec02-F11.
Source: [A09 -> src:rdmv-ct-d:connecticut-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0009]
FACT_ID: sec02-R06 | anchor: A09
Every tester brings the CS-1 eight hour proof, but teen testers stack a second training certificate plus parent teaching proof on top. [A09]
Why it matters: group_hint paperwork; prereq_hint sec02-F13; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec02-F13, sec02-F14, sec02-F15.
Source: [A09 -> src:rdmv-ct-d:connecticut-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0009]
FACT_ID: sec02-R07 | anchor: A10
Qualifiers pocket a temporary paper card at the office the same day, yet the lasting plastic card travels by mail inside twenty days. [A10]
Why it matters: group_hint card-delivery; prereq_hint sec02-F18; difficulty_hint 1; confusable_with sec02-F17, sec02-F18.
Source: [A10 -> src:rdmv-ct-d:connecticut-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0010]
FACT_ID: sec02-R08 | anchor: A10
Joining the donor registry costs nothing at licensing, but flipping the donor choice later demands a duplicate credential and a thirty dollar fee. [A10]
Why it matters: group_hint donor-cost; prereq_hint sec02-F24; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec02-F24, sec02-F25.
Source: [A10 -> src:rdmv-ct-d:connecticut-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0010]
FACT_ID: sec02-R09 | anchor: A11
Voter sign up rides along any license transaction with a three week confirmation, and a plain address change moves the voter record too unless the driver opts out. [A11]
Why it matters: group_hint voter-link; prereq_hint sec02-F26; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec02-F26.
Source: [A11 -> src:rdmv-ct-d:connecticut-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0011]
FACT_ID: sec02-R10 | anchor: A11
Limited licenses add daylight, lens, highway, gear, mirror and equipment curbs for impaired drivers, while commercial and passenger licenses instead face tougher health bars. [A11]
Why it matters: group_hint limited-vs-commercial; prereq_hint sec02-F27; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec02-F27, sec02-F29, sec02-F30.
Source: [A11 -> src:rdmv-ct-d:connecticut-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0011]
